CREATE VIEW exposed.funder_alias_links AS
WITH names AS (
    SELECT id AS funder_id, funder_name AS name FROM exposed.funders
    UNION
    SELECT funder_id, funder_alias FROM exposed.funder_aliases
), normalized AS (
    SELECT funder_id, name,
        lower(btrim(regexp_replace(name, '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g'))) AS normalized_alias
    FROM names
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.funder_id AS left_funder_id, b.funder_id AS right_funder_id,
    a.normalized_alias, a.name AS left_alias, b.name AS right_alias
FROM normalized a JOIN normalized b USING (normalized_alias)
WHERE a.funder_id < b.funder_id AND a.normalized_alias <> '';

CREATE VIEW exposed.funder_alias_groups AS
WITH RECURSIVE edges AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT left_funder_id AS source, right_funder_id AS target
    FROM exposed.funder_alias_links
    UNION
    SELECT right_funder_id, left_funder_id FROM exposed.funder_alias_links
), reachable AS (
    SELECT id AS funder_id, id AS member_id FROM exposed.funders
    UNION
    SELECT r.funder_id, e.target FROM reachable r JOIN edges e ON e.source = r.member_id
)
SELECT funder_id, min(member_id::text)::uuid AS group_id
FROM reachable GROUP BY funder_id;
